lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots; approximately five distinct columns are visible in the mid-flank region between the pectoral and dorsal fin areas.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot alignments, forming a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs, distributed irregularly across the visible surface.
dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.other_distinctive_markers: Unique maze-like or 'W'-shaped high-intensity pixel pattern located on the upper flank immediately posterior to the gill region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated object (likely a remora) is attached to the lateral flank posterior to the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a complex, non-linear maze or 'W' pattern of white pigmentation located in the transition zone between the gills and the mid-flank.
